scope: 36 fresh product-adapter calls; six configurations, three saved public 3×3 WIC image grids, two repeats each. No live image submissions. Native actuator tested separately.
order: CLI/Eve sequential with configuration order reversed in repeat 2, fixture order traffic lights/bridges/bicycles. Nano ran after the 30 CLI/Eve calls on the same device/profile.
models: Requested flags/configurations; provider-resolved identity unavailable. Nano exact managed version/effort not exposed. Jev has no image adapter and is not in an image-accuracy denominator.
groundTruth: Human review of public crops; bridge/bicycle sets also consistent with prior live acceptance. One reviewer; no independent second review.
limits: Three unique images, not 36 independent challenge types.
Image prompts/context differ across Nano/CLI/Eve; this is a product-system comparison.
Model handoff does not establish refusal motive; explanatory prose is not retained by the product schema.
Pixels and full challenge screenshots remain local; hashes and crop bounds identify the exact inputs.
No invoices or operating/device/subscription allocation measured. Nano API cost $0.
